translations.web: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.
translations.bsb: “Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head for them.
translations.kjv: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald
translations.asv: Both great and small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;
